description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/latlon3d/rules/ppm_flux_D_lev_mono_hybrid_noflux_bc -- the TERRAIN-FOLLOWING (hybrid sigma-pressure) upwind-biased, monotone, conservative flux-form vertical advection operator. Pinned here: (1) MASS FORM -- the operator is the RAW face-flux difference F_{k+1/2} - F_{k-1/2} with NO division by a cell thickness (the fixed-grid golden divides by dz[.,.,k]); this is what keeps the vertical divergence conservative when the layers move. (2) TERRAIN-FOLLOWING RECONSTRUCTION -- the CW84 parabola widths are gathered from the RANK-3 physical thickness dp[i,j,k+/-n] (the grid's lev_thickness_3d applied to a 3-D pe = Ap + Bp*Ps), not a 1-D column dz[k]. (3) WHOLE-GRID FORM -- one makearray region over [lon,lat,lev] holding stencils/ppmflux_D_lev_hyb_whole: every cell's two face fluxes with the near-wall window members edge-extended by clamped subscripts (max(k-3,1), ..., min(k+3,NLEV)) and the two wall fluxes selected to zero (ifelse(k < NLEV, F_{k+1/2}, 0) - ifelse(k > 1, F_{k-1/2}, 0)). The compound match D(W*q, wrt: lev) fires at priority 10 with the branch-free max/min upwind donor selection. NLEV = 7 exercises every edge-extended window member.
